title: RLI Named to Ward’s 50® Top Performing Insurance Companies List for 36th Consecutive Year
summary: RLI Corp. (NYSE: RLI) today announced it has been named to the Ward's 50 ® list of top-performing insurance companies for the 36th consecutive year. RLI remains the only company to have appeared on the list every year since its inception in 1991. "We’re honored that RLI has been named to Ward's Top 50 for the 36th consecutive year," said RLI Corp. President CEO Craig Kliethermes. "This recognition reflects the consistency of our performance, the disciplined execution of our long-term strategy and the confidence our distribution partners and policyholders place in our company. We celebrate this achievement with our associate-owners.” Ward benchmarking, a business unit of Aon, is the leading provider of benchmarking and best practices studies for the insurance industry.
